```yaml
name: Performance Benchmark

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

concurrency:
  group: perf-benchmark-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  benchmark:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout PR branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          path: repo-pr

      - name: Checkout main branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          path: repo-main

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: npm

      # PR branch
      - name: Install dependencies (PR)
        run: npm ci
        working-directory: repo-pr

      - name: Build (PR)
        run: npm run build
        working-directory: repo-pr

      - name: Run tests (PR)
        run: npm run test
        working-directory: repo-pr

      - name: Lint (PR)
        run: npm run lint
        working-directory: repo-pr

      # Main branch
      - name: Install dependencies (main)
        run: npm ci
        working-directory: repo-main

      - name: Build (main)
        run: npm run build
        working-directory: repo-main

      - name: Run tests (main)
        run: npm run test
        working-directory: repo-main

      - name: Lint (main)
        run: npm run lint
        working-directory: repo-main

      # Benchmark PR branch
      - name: Benchmark PR branch
        id: bench-pr
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cd repo-pr
          times=()
          for i in {1..2}; do
            npm pack > /dev/null
          done
          for i in {1..5}; do
            start=$(date +%s%N)
            npm pack > /dev/null
            end=$(date +%s%N)
            elapsed=$(( (end - start) / 1000000 ))
            times+=($elapsed)
          done
          sorted=($(printf '%s\n' "${times[@]}" | sort -n))
          median=${sorted[2]}
          echo "median=$median" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      # Benchmark main branch
      - name: Benchmark main branch
        id: bench-main
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cd repo-main
          times=()
          for i in {1..2}; do
            npm pack > /dev/null
          done
          for i in {1..5}; do
            start=$(date +%s%N)
            npm pack > /dev/null
            end=$(date +%s%N)
            elapsed=$(( (end - start) / 1000000 ))
            times+=($elapsed)
          done
          sorted=($(printf '%s\n' "${times[@]}" | sort -n))
          median=${sorted[2]}
          echo "median=$median" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      # Compute difference
      - name: Compute difference
        id: diff
        run: |
          pr=${{ steps.bench-pr.outputs.median }}
          main=${{ steps.bench-main.outputs.median }}
          diff=$((pr - main))
          percent=$(( diff * 100 / main ))
          echo "pr=$pr" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "main=$main" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "diff=$diff" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "percent=$percent" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      # Post comment
      - name: Post benchmark comment
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        env:
          PR_MEDIAN: ${{ steps.bench-pr.outputs.median }}
          MAIN_MEDIAN: ${{ steps.bench-main.outputs.median }}
          DIFF: ${{ steps.diff.outputs.diff }}
          PERCENT: ${{ steps.diff.outputs.percent }}
        with:
          script: |
            const { context, github } = require('@actions/github');
            const prNumber = context.issue.number;
            const marker = '<!-- perf-benchmark -->';
            const prMs = Number(process.env.PR_MEDIAN);
            const mainMs = Number(process.env.MAIN_MEDIAN);
            const diffMs = Number(process.env.DIFF);
            const percent = Number(process.env.PERCENT);
            const prSec = (prMs / 1000).toFixed(2);
            const mainSec = (mainMs / 1000).toFixed(2);
            const diffSec = (Math.abs(diffMs) / 1000).toFixed(2);
            const diffSign = diffMs >= 0 ? '+' : '-';
            const percentSign = percent >= 0 ? '+' : '-';
            const commentBody = `
${marker}
| | Time |
|---|---:|
| PR branch | ${prSec}s |
| main branch | ${mainSec}s |
| **Diff** | **${diffSign}${diffSec}s (${percentSign}${percent}%)** |
`;
            const { data: comments } = await github.rest.issues.listComments({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: prNumber,
            });
            const existing = comments.find(c => c.body.includes(marker));
            if (existing) {
              await github.rest.issues.updateComment({
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                comment_id: existing.id,
                body: commentBody,
              });
            } else {
              await github.rest.issues.createComment({
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                issue_number: prNumber,
                body: commentBody,
              });
            }
```
